newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman shares lifted by banking, investment gains.
newsitem.headline: Oman shares lifted by banking, investment gains.

text.p: Oman's share index inched higher in buoyant trade in the week to Wednesday, supported by gains in the banking and investment sector, the Muscat Securities Market said.
It said the index ended at a new high of 188.70 points, up from 188.22 a week earlier.
Of the 59 stocks traded in the week, 19 rose, 24 suffered a negligible decline and 16 were unchanged, the stock market said.
A total of 2.17 million shares were traded in 877 deals, up from 1.62 million shares in 786 deals in the previous week.
The banking and investment sector dominated the market, accounting for 78 percent of total trading value of 3.98 million rials ($10.4 million) from 3.37 million rials a week earlier.
The Oman Development Bank led financial stocks, with 750,000 shares worth 1.07 million rials changing hands. The stock ended the week at 1.540 rials, compared with 1.470 a week earlier.
Oman International Bank also closed firmer at 2.880 rials, up from 2.810 the previous week. Some 125,000 shares in the bank worth 355,000 rials were traded.
National Gas rose to 4.080 from 3.950 a week earlier. National Biscuit Industries closed at 2.400 roals from a previous 2.300.
